fields.Name: PS truth datasets: load and verify
fields.Description: Bundle 'ps-truth-datasets': every truth-suite catalog entry at every base seed (68 datasets: 8 worlds × 4 seeds, W2-noise × 21, 15 scenarios × 1) is generated, loaded into its pstruth table in one transaction, and its entity reads back exactly the loaded row count through MJAPI.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 68 of 68 datasets load and read back their exact row count through MJAPI.
